capabilities: Insert highlight blocks, quotes, code and native Markdown tables
Create 2–5 column layouts with titles and draggable dividers
Format selected text, colors, links and indentation from a toolbar
Insert wikilinks to vault notes by title, path or alias
Pin favorite features and card modules in the insertion panel
disambiguation: Not a 3D or visualization tool; it inserts content blocks and column layouts into notes.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or later; some interface and command labels may appear in Chinese; development source is private; Home and Magical Cards keep their own licenses.
problem: Adding styled blocks, multi-column layouts and note links in Obsidian means writing Markdown or HTML by hand.

relations.evidence: Home and Magical Cards connections are experimental and off by default.
Both require compatible companion plugins; further development is pending.

summary: Editing panel that inserts content blocks, column layouts and note links, with a toolbar for formatting selected text.
